feats.title: Precise Hunter
feats.description: When you score a critical hit against the target of your Hunter's Quarry with a ranged attack, your allies gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls against that target until the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Agile Running Attack
feats.description: When you move as part of using a skirmisher attack power, you ignore difficult terrain.

feats.title: Flank on the Run
feats.description: Whenever you are adjacent to an enemy and move to another square adjacent to that enemy, you do not provoke an opportunity attack from that enemy for leaving your square.

feats.title: Hobbling Strike
feats.description: Whenever you would deal Hunter's Quarry damage, you can forgo one die of that damage to slow the target until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Hunter’s Aim
feats.description: You don't take the normal –2 penalty to attack rolls against your quarry if it has cover or concealment.

feats.title: Lethal Hunter
feats.description: The extra damage dice from your Hunter's Quarry class feature increase from d6s to d8s.

feats.title: Second Shot
feats.description: You can designate the second-nearest enemy as your quarry instead of the nearest enemy.

feats.title: Staggering Strike
feats.description: Whenever you would deal Hunter's Quarry damage to an enemy, you can forgo one die of that damage to push that enemy 1 square.

feats.title: Swift Footwork
feats.description: Whenever you use a martial encounter or daily power that allows you to shift, you can shift 2 extra squares.
